rewrite.rewritten_title: OEM Wheel Swaps for Chevrolet Vehicles
rewrite.summary: This thread showcases various owners sharing their experiences and images of swapping original equipment manufacturer (OEM) wheels on different Chevrolet models, including Silverados, Tahoes, and Yukons.
rewrite.rewritten_article_markdown: This thread discusses various owners sharing their experiences with swapping original equipment manufacturer (OEM) wheels on different Chevrolet models. One user, @polyanskiyalex, posted about his current Chrome Teardrop wheels and was interested in swapping to brushed or brushed-like wheels for a H2 HUMMER.

evidence.article_excerpt: This thread discusses various owners sharing their experiences with swapping original equipment manufacturer (OEM) wheels on different Chevrolet models.
One user, @polyanskiyalex, posted about his current Chrome Teardrop wheels and was interested in swapping to brushed or brushed-like wheels for a H2 HUMMER.

post_rewrites.rewritten_content: Share your original equipment (OEM) wheel swaps, such as upgrading from OEM chrome teardrop wheels to newer models like H2 or Chevrolet Escalade wheels. I'm considering swapping my current OEM wheels for nicer ones. Thanks.
2004 CCSB H2 and HUMMER Silverado wheel centers
Are the parts chrome-plated or brushed finish? The ones I'm considering are brushed, so I might use my existing center caps from my wheels. Thanks.
02 Silverado wheels on a 03 Tahoe.

Originally Posted by polyanskiyalex

Those are chrome, not brushed. I purchased them from eBay for $300 and picked them up locally as they were about 45 miles away. For a brushed finish, consider matching gray center caps.

Your truck is either a 1500 with a 6-bolt pattern or a 2500 with an 8-bolt pattern. I have an 8-bolt, so I used H2 wheels. If you have a 6-bolt pattern, use H3 wheels instead.
Currently, I have 03+ Tahoe Z71 wheels with 285 tires. Previously, I used Denali tires.
I just realized I have 6 lugs instead of 8, so the H2 wheels won't fit. Does anyone have Escalade wheels available?
Do these 2007 Classic model Nissan Titan/Armada wheels fit the 400 model? They would have enhanced the look.
Yes, because they share the same 6x5.5 bolt pattern as the observed one.
